logp.method_description: The lipophilicity of the ruthenium(III) complexes (1–6) was determined using the shake-flask method [57]. The complexes 1–6 were dissolved at a concentration of 0.30 mg mL-l in 2.5 mL of the organic phase (n-octanol), and an equal volume of the aqueous sodium chloride phase (0.9% w/v) was added. The solution was then mixed mechanically in plastic tubes for 30 min, followed by centrifugation (6000 rpm, 15 min). After separation, the phases were analyzed using UV–Vis spectroscopy to determine the amount of compound in each phase. The absorption values before and after shaking were compared. The partition coefficient (log Po/w) in both phases for each compound was calculated based on Lambert–Beer’s Law. For each complex, the procedure was repeated five times.
